message: We’ve all had those moments where we think, "I’m so glad I prepared for this!" 🚗 It’s amazing how a little planning can make a big difference, especially when it comes to our vehicles. Whether it’s knowing what to pack for a road trip or having a plan for unexpected weather, having the right information can give us peace of mind on the road. We love sharing resources that help us all feel a bit more ready for whatever comes our way. What’s one tip you have for staying prepared while driving?
